messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning a base-image cutover tomorrow 09:00 PT to remove NET_ADMIN and drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN where possible. Will also rotate the keystore operator to use ephemeral envelopes via KMS.

jordan: +1 on NET_ADMIN removal. which services will need hostNetwork exemptions?

maya: only the legacy debug-proxy (should be canaried off). list in the infra PR.

samir: KMS envelope flow question — are we switching to envelope keys per-cluster or per-region?

maya: per-cluster for now. reduces blast radius and matches our keystore role boundaries.

leah: audit log retention asks: SOC wants 1y immutable; how will that work when logs are encrypted w/ cluster KMS?

maya: logs will be encrypted with KMS and pushed to exfil-locked bucket. retention governed by bucket policy + attestable object metadata. ops-bot: note: ticket SEC-4387 created for retention policy.

jordan: re: container hardening — adding a pre-start hook to assert /proc/sys nets not writable and verify userns remap active. snippet:
```
# check kernel flags
if grep -q "userns" /proc/filesystems; then
  echo ok
else
  exit 1
fi
```

samir: we should also verify cosign signatures after the rebase. add a post-deploy check: `cosign verify --bundle` against signer key.

maya: agreed. plan: canary for 2 clusters (staging+canary-prod) for 4 hours, run vuln-scan and cosign validation, then stagger rest. rollback plan: tag previous image as fallback, keep old keystore operator in cold standby.

leah: incident response note — if keystore rotation fails, we need immediate fallback path to decrypt current envelopes. who owns that runbook?

maya: samir + leah. I'll add runbook steps to SEC-4387: decrypt with admin KMS key, re-encrypt with previous envelope. make sure @oncall knows the command.

jordan: tiny ask: update RBAC to remove `system:masters` bindings from bake-runner service account before cutover. we'll need a migration PR that logs changes to audit.

maya: noted — PR will include an audit-change tag and will touch the keystore RoleBindings.

samir: quick test commands for rollout team:
```
# verify no NET_ADMIN in running containers
kubectl get pods -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.drop}' | grep NET_ADMIN && echo BAD || echo OK
# validate cosign
cosign verify --bundle -key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign
```

leah: anything needing legal/compliance signoff before we flip?

maya: SOC already pinged; legal only if retention changes. I'll cc them on SEC-4387.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: [ ] infra PR open, [ ] RBAC PR open, [ ] cosign signer rotated, [ ] canary clusters scheduled, [ ] runbook attached to ticket SEC-4387.

jordan: I'll take RBAC PR and schedule a short pairing to ensure bindings are minimal. ETA 3pm today.

maya: thanks — tagging final owner list in the ticket. will post a 30m heads-up in #release-war-room 30m before cutover. :rocket:
